SpaceXSI: Grok Bot Daily Preview
Grok Bot upcoming updates, spotted in prerelease builds since yesterday (1.1.0-pre.17 → pre.27)

👥 Sharing and teams:
🤖 Data sharing to improve Grok Bot
🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Team bot account access
🤝 Oversized files go to Drive or OneDrive
⭐ Response rating and feedback
🤝 Shared Bot from a chat
🧩 Shared skills mention team memory
📵 Texting your Bot is off

💳 Payments and orders:
📊 Usage, weekly limit, and on-demand spend
🛒 Gift checkout with arrival dates
🧾 Checkout paid-with line

💬 Chat:
✍️ Result feedback

🗺️ Places and bookings:
🖼️ Yelp hours, photos, and reviews
🖼️ Open places and photos in Google Maps

📄 Pages and routines:
⏱️ Re-run a routine
⏱️ Who can use this routine

📞 Calls:
☎️ Send context to a call
💬 Unlink phone from a team bot line

🔌 Connectors:
📧 Connect Google apps

✨ Other:
🤖 Numbered bot labels
✅ Bulk approvals
🤖 Bot files
✨ Reset and end countdowns

🎥 Videos of some of these features are in the comments 👇

Note: These changes may or may not be available when this ships to the public. Based on unofficial 3rd-party SI analysis of prerelease builds.
